## 4. Findings that constrain the project

1. **One cycle only.** `Cycle_Index` is 1 in every file that has it; each file holds a single charge–rest–discharge–rest–charge sequence. There is **no ageing data** → SOH-vs-cycle and RUL cannot be built.
2. **Single cell, no cell-level data** → no imbalance diagnosis, no cross-cell generalisation.
3. **No temperature channel** except one single reading (23.0 °C) in the file labelled 25 °C. Temperatures 0/25/45 °C come from file names only (**unverified labels**); the 1 A file has no temperature information at all.
4. **Nominal capacity is not documented** in the files. It is not assumed; SOH(%) is disabled. Delivered capacities (to the 2.5 V cut-off): see `results/metrics/soh_capacity_table.csv`.
5. **No independently measured SOC.** The SOC reference is calculated by coulomb integration (see `docs/METHODOLOGY.md`).
6. The 0.1 A tests start the discharge at 4.16–4.18 V after a 2 h rest (not at a CV-terminated 4.2 V), and the 25 °C / 45 °C charge phases stop near 4.15 V (incomplete charge). Therefore the SOC reference is defined on the **discharge** only.
7. Delivered capacity at 45 °C (2.022 Ah) is lower than at 25 °C (2.157 Ah), which is not the usual temperature trend at equal low rate. The tests were recorded months apart (Oct 2015 – Feb 2016) on a cell with unknown history, so temperature, rate and history effects are confounded; this is reported, not explained away.
8. Event-driven logging: 0 °C and 1 A files log on voltage change (gaps up to 10 s, mostly during rest); 25/45 °C files log every 1 s (integer ms/mA resolution, one 5–7 s gap at 25 °C). All signals are linearly resampled to a uniform 20 s grid for modelling.
